v4.6.138 — Fix AI bots failing on a retired model

🛠 Bots whose saved AI model was a now-retired Claude model (e.g. claude-3-5-haiku-20241022) were failing every AI call with a 404 'model not found'. Retired model IDs are now auto-migrated to their current replacement at call time, so a stale setting can't break a bot — and the retired model is removed from the picker.

Your DAY/LONG/SHORT bots have already been moved to the current Haiku model on the server.

Update via the in-app banner.
